<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@400;700&family=Source+Sans+3:wght@400;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>#tt-trainings-765 h1,#tt-trainings-765 h2,#tt-trainings-765 h3{color:inherit;font-weight:700;font-style:normal;letter-spacing:normal;text-transform:none}
#tt-trainings-765 p{font-size:inherit}
#tt-trainings-765 blockquote{border:0;font-style:normal}
#tt-trainings-765 a{box-shadow:none}
#tt-trainings-765 figure{padding:0}
#tt-trainings-765 img{vertical-align:middle}
#tt-trainings-765{--tt-blue:#626E98;--tt-blue-soft:#EBECF2;--tt-blue-mid:#C5CADB;--tt-yellow:#FFE193;--tt-pink:#EEBCBC;--tt-pink-btn:#FFD3DE;--tt-yellow-bg:#FFF4D6;--tt-pink-bg:#FFF0F4;--tt-white:#fff;--tt-gap:44px;font-family:"Source Sans 3",sans-serif;color:var(--tt-blue);font-size:17px;font-weight:400;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 *{box-sizing:border-box}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-container{width:min(1160px,calc(100% - 48px));margin:0 auto}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-kicker{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:18px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-title{margin:0;font-size:48px;line-height:1.24;font-weight:700;color:var(--tt-blue)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-section-title{margin:0;font-size:40px;line-height:1.16;font-weight:700}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-button{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:13px 24px;border-radius:20px 0 20px 20px;background:var(--tt-yellow);color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-size:13px;line-height:1;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;transition:.2s ease}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-button:hover{background:var(--tt-pink-btn);color:var(--tt-blue);transform:translateY(-2px)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-steps-heading .tt-kicker,#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how .tt-kicker,#tt-trainings-765 .tt-formats>.tt-container>.tt-kicker,#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefits-head .tt-kicker,#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-copy .tt-kicker{margin-bottom:0;line-height:1.65}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero{padding:64px 0 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.3fr) minmax(350px,1fr);gap:56px;align-items:center}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero-copy{padding:18px 0 12px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero-copy>.tt-kicker{margin:0 0 16px;font-size:18px;line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-title-line{display:block;white-space:nowrap}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero-meta{margin-top:24px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero .tt-button{margin-top:26px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero-photo{aspect-ratio:4/3;border-radius:64px 64px 0 64px;overflow:hidden;background:var(--tt-blue-soft);position:relative}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-hero-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:center;display:block}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-steps{padding:66px 0 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-steps-heading{margin-bottom:16px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-steps-heading .tt-section-title{color:var(--tt-pink)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step{min-height:336px;padding:24px 22px 26px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step:nth-child(1){background:var(--tt-blue-soft);border-radius:50px 50px 50px 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step:nth-child(2){background:var(--tt-blue-soft);border-radius:50px 50px 0 50px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step:nth-child(3){background:var(--tt-blue-soft);border-radius:50px 0 50px 50px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step:nth-child(4){background:var(--tt-blue-soft);border-radius:50px 50px 0 50px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step-visual{height:205px;margin-bottom:18px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step-visual img{display:block;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;width:auto;height:auto;object-fit:contain}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:22px;line-height:1.27}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step p{margin:0;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how{padding:64px 0 22px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.78fr 1.22fr;gap:86px;align-items:start}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how .tt-section-title{color:var(--tt-yellow)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-list{display:grid;gap:28px;padding-top:2px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-item{display:grid;grid-template-columns:50px 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-num{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50px 50px 50px 0;background:var(--tt-blue-soft);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-item:nth-child(2) .tt-num{background:var(--tt-yellow-bg);border-radius:50px 50px 0 50px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-item:nth-child(3) .tt-num{background:var(--tt-pink-bg);border-radius:50px 0 50px 50px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-item h3{margin:0 0 7px;font-size:23px;line-height:1.27}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-how-item p{margin:0;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-formats{padding:0;margin-top:-26px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-formats .tt-section-title{color:var(--tt-pink);margin-bottom:16px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card{padding:32px 28px 30px;min-height:385px;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card:nth-child(1){background:var(--tt-blue-soft);border-radius:60px 60px 60px 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card:nth-child(2){background:var(--tt-pink-bg);border-radius:60px 60px 0 60px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card:nth-child(3){background:var(--tt-yellow-bg);border-radius:60px 0 60px 60px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:28px;line-height:1.25}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card .tt-sub{margin:0 0 18px;font-weight:600}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-card p{margin:0 0 13px;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-format-meta{margin-top:auto!important;padding-top:18px;font-weight:600}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-secondary-link{display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;margin-top:18px;padding:0;color:var(--tt-blue);font-size:15px;font-weight:700;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:4px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile{padding:18px 0 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-wrap{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:64px;align-items:start}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-copy .tt-section-title{color:var(--tt-blue)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-copy p{margin:16px 0 0;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-visual{margin:48px 0 0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-image{width:auto;max-width:100%;height:auto;max-height:374px;display:block;border:1px solid #E3E5EC;border-radius:0;box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(98,110,152,.11)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-profile-caption{margin-top:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.04em}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefits{padding:0;margin-top:0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefits-panel{padding:0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefits-head{margin-bottom:16px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefits .tt-section-title{color:var(--tt-pink)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit-track{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 36px)/3);gap:18px;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scroll-behavior:smooth;scrollbar-width:none}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit-track::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit{scroll-snap-align:start;min-height:190px;padding:26px 24px;background:var(--tt-blue-soft);border-radius:36px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit:nth-child(1){border-radius:36px 36px 36px 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit:nth-child(2){border-radius:36px 36px 0 36px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit:nth-child(3){border-radius:36px 0 36px 36px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit:nth-child(4){border-radius:0 36px 36px 36px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit:nth-child(5){border-radius:36px 0 36px 36px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit:nth-child(6){border-radius:36px 36px 0 36px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit h3{margin:0 0 9px;font-size:21px;line-height:1.3}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-benefit p{margin:0;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-carousel-dots{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:2px;margin-top:16px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-carousel-dot{width:18px;height:18px;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;cursor:pointer;display:grid;place-items:center}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-carousel-dot:before{content:"";width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#DDE0E9;transition:background .2s ease,transform .2s ease}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-carousel-dot[aria-current="true"]:before{background:var(--tt-blue);transform:scale(1.12)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-proof{padding:16px 0 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-proof-panel{background:var(--tt-yellow-bg);border-radius:0 70px 70px 70px;padding:38px 40px 44px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-proof .tt-kicker{margin-bottom:24px;color:var(--tt-yellow);font-size:40px;line-height:1.16}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-quotes{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:30px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-quote{margin:0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-quote p{margin:0 0 14px;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-quote strong{font-size:14px}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-cta{padding:var(--tt-gap) 0 var(--tt-gap)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-cta-panel{background:var(--tt-pink-bg);border-radius:70px 70px 70px 0;padding:38px 40px 44px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:54px;align-items:center}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-cta .tt-section-title{color:var(--tt-pink)}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-cta p{margin:15px 0 0;line-height:1.45}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-footer{background:var(--tt-blue);padding:30px 0 24px;color:#fff;border-radius:70px 0 0 0}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-footer-grid{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:32px;align-items:center}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-footer p{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.6}
#tt-trainings-765 .tt-footer a{color:#fff;text-decoration:none}
@media(max-width:900px){#tt-trainings-765 .tt-step-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}

@media(max-width:850px){#tt-trainings-765 .tt-container{width:min(100% - 32px,1160px)}
